claims.claim: 马林塔尔研究的起因是 1930 年当地纺织厂关闭,1,200 名工人和 90 名职员同时失业——这是一个全村几乎同时失业的「整体失业社区」,而非个体失业样本。
claims.quote: 1.200 Arbeiterinnen und Arbeiter sowie 90 Angestellte verloren im Jahr 1930 ihre Arbeit.
claims.source_title: Reinhard Müller / Museum Marienthal (AGSÖ, Universität Graz), 2012, Museum Marienthal Folder
claims.notes: 来源是 Jahoda 遗稿所在的格拉茨大学 AGSÖ 档案馆策展材料,不是 1933 原书;原书受版权保护,网上未见合法全文。brief 要求的「478 户」「失业救济仍在发放」原文数字未能回到一手,见 open_questions。关键外推意义:马林塔尔恰恰是『周围人全都失业』的情形,但仍出现严重的『疲惫社区』——与 Clark 2003 的社会规范缓冲效应形成张力。

claims.claim: 马林塔尔的核心结论『疲惫的社区』(müde Gemeinschaft):相当一部分失业者表现为听天由命、丧失行动能力、被强制无所事事压垮,并且去政治化——与当时社会主义阵营『失业者是革命者』的设想相反。
claims.quote: Unter den Schlussfolgerungen der Marienthal-Studie besaß jene der ›müden Gemeinschaft‹ besondere politische Brisanz: Die bei einem erheblichen Teil der Arbeitslosen festgestellte Resignation, Aktivitätsunfähigkeit und Überforderung durch erzwungenes Nichtstun sowie die im Zuge der Untersuchung festgestellte Entpolitisierung großer Teile der Arbeitslosen liefen der im sozialistischen Lager damals populären Idee des Arbeitslosen als
claims.source_title: Reinhard Müller / Museum Marienthal (AGSÖ, Universität Graz), 2012, Museum Marienthal Folder
claims.notes: 引文逐字取自档案馆对原书结论的转述,不是 Jahoda 等 1933 原文,故标 paraphrase。『去政治化』一点对本期『公民议价权』线有直接意义:没有工作的人群并没有更具政治动员力。研究设计为 1931-32 年田野民族志 + 时间使用表,非对照研究。

claims.claim: 马林塔尔方法上首创时间使用表:失业者逐小时填写活动;一名男子在上午 10–11 点一栏写下『……等着等着就到中午了』——时间结构瓦解的标志性证据。
claims.quote: Diese Bögen wurden von den Forscherinnen an die Arbeitslosen ausgegeben, damit sie darin für jede Stunde des Tages ihre jeweiligen Aktivitäten notieren. Einer der Männer trug für die Stunde von 10.00–11.00 Uhr den Satz »… einstweilen wird es Mittag« ein.
claims.source_title: Reinhard Müller / Museum Marienthal (AGSÖ, Universität Graz), 2012, Museum Marienthal Folder
claims.notes: 逐字为档案馆文本,其中引用的原书条目(»… einstweilen wird es Mittag«)为原书转引。Paul 等 2023 对 Jahoda et al. 1933/1975 p.83 的概述:突然多出的时间成为『tragic gift』,导致『chaotic and squandered days』。

claims.claim: 马林塔尔的伤害不能干净地归因于『非收入功能』:当时失业者获得的经济支持远低于当代西方水平,Paul 认为该研究可能反映的是存在一条『绝对贫困线』(饥饿、缺衣),越过即必然导致绝望与冷漠。
claims.quote: This study, conducted at a time when unemployed people received much less financial support than is usual today in Western countries, suggests that there might exist a level of absolute poverty, characterized by starvation and a lack of clothing, that does inevitably lead to despair, apathy and other signs of severe distress (the “broken attitude” in the terminology of Jahoda et al., 1933/1975, p. 96).
claims.source_title: Karsten I. Paul, 2005, The negative mental health effect of unemployment: Meta-analyses of cross-sectional and longitudinal data, Dissertation FAU Erlangen-Nürnberg
claims.notes: 口径陷阱:常被当作『有钱也没用,缺的是工作』证据的马林塔尔,其实是『救济在发但很微薄且会断』的情形——收入与潜在功能在此高度混淆。救济仍在发放这一事实说明它不是零收入,但也绝非 UBI 级别的充足保障。

claims.claim: Jahoda 潜在剥夺模型:就业除了显性功能(挣钱)还有五种潜在功能——时间结构、社会接触、集体目标、地位/身份、规律活动;她认为在现代社会只有就业能充分提供这些功能。
claims.quote: She specified five latent functions of employment: “time structure, an enlarged social network, participation in collective efforts, definition of social identity, and required regular activity” (Jahoda, 1997, p. 318). Jahoda (1983) stated that these latent functions correspond to “deep seated needs” (p. 298).
claims.source_title: Karsten I. Paul, 2005, dissertation (quoting Jahoda 1997, 1983)
claims.notes: Jahoda 1981 American Psychologist 36(2):184-191 与 1982 Employment and Unemployment (Cambridge UP) 原文均为付费墙/纸本,未取得;此处五功能措辞是 Paul 转引 Jahoda 1997 词典条目,非 1981/1982 原文。引文已对照 Paul 2005 PDF 逐字核对(跨行断字已合并)。Paul 等 2023 用的另一套措辞『time structure, social contact, collective purpose, status, and activity』是后人简称,不是 Jahoda 原话——引用时勿混用。

claims.claim: Fryer 的能动性限制理论批评 Jahoda 把人看成被动、受外部驱动的存在;认为人是主动追求自我决定的能动者,失业之所以伤人,是因为它伴随贫困、对未来的不确定和社会权力低下,从而限制和挫败能动性。
claims.quote: In contrast to this, Fryer (1986, 1997a) assumes humans to be “agents actively striving for purposeful self-determination, attempting to make sense of, initiate, influence, and cope with events in line with personal values, goals, and expectations of the future” (1997a, p. 12). However, unemployment severely restricts and frustrates agency as well as undermines planning and purposeful action because it is usually associated with poverty, future insecurity, and low social power.
claims.source_title: Karsten I. Paul, 2005, dissertation (summarising Fryer 1986 Social Behaviour 1:3-23; Fryer 1997)
claims.notes: Fryer 1986 原文未找到在线全文,经 Paul 转述/转引。对 UBI 的含义:若 Fryer 对,伤害主要来自贫困+不确定+无权,则永久、无条件、充足的收入理论上可补大部分;若 Jahoda 对,则补不上。两者在多数现实失业数据中无法分离——这是本线最大的识别问题。

claims.claim: Paul & Batinic 对德国代表性样本(N=998)的检验:就业者在时间结构、社会接触、集体目标、活动四项上高于失业者和非劳动力(学生、家庭主妇、退休者);地位/身份一项就业者与非劳动力无差异,但失业者低于所有其他组。
claims.quote: For the fifth of Jahoda's dimensions, identity/status, no significant differences between employed persons and persons who are out of the labor force could be identified. However, unemployed persons reported less status than all other groups did. Thus, Jahoda's model was clearly endorsed for four of the five latent functions of employment and partly endorsed for the fifth function.
claims.source_title: Paul & Batinic, 2010, The need for work: Jahoda's latent functions of employment in a representative sample of the German population, Journal of Organizational Behavior 31:45-64
claims.notes: 摘要文本经 OpenAlex 摘要索引重建(与出版社摘要同序)。横截面;LAMB 量表自评。『地位』只在失业者身上缺失、非劳动力不缺失——提示地位损失是失业的污名效应,而非『不工作』本身;这正是外推到『大家都不工作』时最关键的一项。

claims.claim: Selenko 等四波追踪(T1 N=1,026):交叉滞后 SEM 显示潜在功能剥夺会导致 6 个月后心理健康下降;就业/失业/非劳动力之间的痛苦差异有一部分可由潜在功能获取差异解释。
claims.quote: Multiple mediation analyses show the expected differences in distress between the employed, unemployed, and OLF persons and indicate that part of this difference can be explained by differential access to the latent benefits. Furthermore, cross‐lagged structural equation modelling confirms that a deprivation of latent benefits leads to a decrease in psychological health 6 months later.
claims.source_title: Selenko, Batinic & Paul, 2011, Does latent deprivation lead to psychological distress? Investigating Jahoda's model in a four-wave study, Journal of Occupational and Organizational Psychology 84:723-740
claims.notes: OpenAlex 摘要。『part of』——中介只解释部分差异。观察性面板,交叉滞后不等于因果识别。

claims.claim: Paul 等 2023 meta:潜在与显性功能合计解释心理健康 19% 的方差;单项中财务状况 β=0.20 最大,其次集体目标 0.16、时间结构 0.15、地位 0.13、社会接触 0.05、活动 0.03——五项潜在功能合计权重远超收入,但收入是最大的单一预测因子。
claims.quote: Results showed that, together, the latent and manifest functions explained 19% of the variance in mental health (see Table 5). All six manifest and latent functions emerged as significant predictors of mental health in this analysis. The effects were of small-to-medium size, with financial situation β = 0.20, p < 0.001, collective purpose β = 0.16, p < 0.001, time structure β = 0.15, p < 0.001, status β = 0.13, p < 0.001, social contact β = 0.05, p < 0.001, and activity β = 0.03, p = 0.014.
claims.source_title: Paul, Scholl, Moser, Zechmann & Batinic, 2023, Employment status, psychological needs, and mental health: Meta-analytic findings concerning the latent deprivation model, Frontiers in Psychology 14:1017358
claims.notes: 基于元分析相关矩阵的回归(MASEM 类),全部为横截面自评,不是因果分解。『集体目标』(被他人需要)单项仅次于钱——对 AI 场景最有指向性。CC BY 开放获取。

claims.claim: 同一 meta 发现退休者几乎与失业者一样缺乏潜在功能(但不缺显性收入功能),学生接近就业者——即『不工作』本身确实减少时间结构等功能,但退休者通常并不像失业者那样痛苦(见 J17),提示潜在功能缺失≠伤害。
claims.quote: Specific analyses for three OLF-subgroups found retired people to be almost as deprived of the latent functions (but not the manifest function) as unemployed people, while students were more similar to employed people but still experienced some manifest and latent deprivation. For homemakers, the effect sizes pointed in the expected direction, but they were not significant.
claims.source_title: Paul et al., 2023, Frontiers in Psychology 14:1017358
claims.notes: 这是对 Jahoda 理论的关键反面线索:退休者缺乏潜在功能却不如失业者痛苦,说明决定伤害的可能是规范/身份(该不该工作)而不仅是功能缺失。作者自己也提出『低地位可能是失业特有的污名』这一替代解释。

claims.claim: Paul 2005 横截面 meta(即 Paul & Moser 2009 JVB 的底稿):k=323 个样本、n=458,820,失业者心理健康问题效应量 d=0.54(95% CI 0.50–0.57);剔除离群值后 d=0.51;失业者中处于心理问题风险者占 34%,就业者 16%。
claims.quote: With an average weighted effect size of d = 0.54 (k = 323, n = 458,820) the overall effect was of medium size with a narrow confidence interval from 0.50 to 0.57, clearly excluding effects of small size (see table 3).
claims.source_title: Karsten I. Paul, 2005, dissertation (basis of Paul & Moser 2009, JVB 74:264-282)
claims.notes: 口径陷阱:JVB 2009 正式版(237 项横截面 + 87 项纵向研究)付费墙未取得,正式版数字以 d=0.51、34% vs 16% 广为引用,与本论文『剔除离群后 d=0.51』『34% vs 16%』一致,但样本数可能有出入;引用时应注明来自 2005 博士论文。测量为精神健康量表(GHQ、CES-D 等),不是生活满意度。

claims.claim: 纵向 meta:就业者失业后痛苦显著上升(d=0.19),失业者再就业后痛苦显著下降(d=-0.35)——支持『失业导致痛苦』的社会因果方向;工厂关闭类准实验研究 d=0.38,与其他研究无显著差异。
claims.quote: For employed persons who lost their jobs, a significant increase in distress was found (d = 0.19). For unemployed persons who found new jobs, a significant decrease in distress was found (d = -0.35).
claims.source_title: Karsten I. Paul, 2005, dissertation
claims.notes: 工厂关闭:『Studies examining persons affected by a factory closure or a mass-layoff had slightly smaller effect sizes (d = 0.38)… This difference was not significant』。注意纵向 d 远小于横截面 d(0.19 vs 0.54),部分差距可能来自选择效应或测量时点。

claims.claim: 失业保护水平的调节作用不稳:高失业保护国家效应量较小(d=0.46 vs 0.58,p=0.003),但控制研究设计后差异缩小且不再显著(0.41 vs 0.49,p=0.15)——慷慨的救济能缓冲一部分,但远不能消除失业的精神健康伤害。
claims.quote: In countries with a high level of unemployment protection, the effect sizes were significantly weaker than in countries with a medium or low level of unemployment protection (unemployment protection high (d = 0.46 vs. d = 0,58, Qb = 8.61; p = 0.0033). After the exclusion of possibly biasing studies, the difference between the average effect sizes was slightly reduced and not significant any longer (d = 0.41 vs. d = 0.49, Qb = 2.03; p = 0.1539).
claims.source_title: Karsten I. Paul, 2005, dissertation
claims.notes: 国家层面的生态比较(12 国高保护 vs 其他),且与收入不平等高度共线(作者指出 12 个高保护国中 10 个是低不平等国家)。即便在最慷慨的保护下 d≈0.41——仍是中等效应。

claims.claim: McKee-Ryan 等 2005 meta(104 项研究、437 个效应量):失业者心理与身体健康均差于就业者;失业持续时间与样本类型有调节作用,但当期失业率和失业救济金额都没有调节作用;失业者中『工作角色中心度』与心理健康关系强于人力资本和人口学变量。
claims.quote: Unemployment duration and sample type (school leaver vs. mature unemployed) moderated the relationship between mental health and unemployment, but the current unemployment rate and the amount of unemployment benefits did not. Within unemployed samples, work-role centrality, coping resources (personal, social, financial, and time structure), cognitive appraisals, and coping strategies displayed stronger relationships with mental health than did human capital or demographic variables.
claims.source_title: McKee-Ryan, Song, Wanberg & Kinicki, 2005, Psychological and physical well-being during unemployment: a meta-analytic study, Journal of Applied Psychology 90(1):53-76
claims.notes: 与 Paul 2005 在『救济是否调节』上冲突:McKee-Ryan 不显著、Paul 显著但不稳;Paul 归因于统计功效差异。两份 meta 都说明『钱的多少』至少不是失业伤害的主开关。工作中心度越高、失业越痛——意味着伤害与个人把工作当身份的程度相关,而这是可被文化改变的。

claims.claim: Winkelmann & Winkelmann(德国 SOEP,1984–89,20–64 岁男性,个体固定效应 logit):失业的非金钱成本远大于收入损失;按收入系数 0.13 推算,要抵消失业的满意度下降,收入需增加约 7 倍(对数单位);若失业使收入减半,金钱成本 0.13×0.5 远小于非金钱成本 0.96。
claims.quote: Based on the fixed effects logit income estimate of 0·13, the compensating variation is roughly 7. This number suggests that income would need to be increased tremendously in order to trigger an increase in satisfaction large enough to just offset the adverse effect of unemployment. Moreover, it also suggests that the pecuniary costs of unemployment are relatively small. If we assume an unem- ployment-induced income reduction of 50%, the estimated pecuniary costs of unemployment of A0·13 ∗ 0·5 fall substantially short of the non-pecuniary cost of A0·96.
claims.source_title: Liliana Winkelmann & Rainer Winkelmann, 1998, Why Are the Unemployed So Unhappy? Evidence from Panel Data, Economica 65(257):1-15
claims.notes: N=20,944 观测;因变量是二分化的生活满意度(≤7 为不满意)。『A0·13』为 PDF 中负号的 OCR 乱码(即 −0.13/−0.96)。口径陷阱:补偿变差依赖于收入系数,而收入系数在固定效应下被测量误差严重衰减(收入在个体内变化小),所以『需要 7 倍收入』很可能高估了非金钱成本;同时只看男性。论文同时报告:非劳动力(OLF)效应为负但显著小于失业,且失业满意度与失业持续时长无关(无适应)。

claims.claim: 同文:失业效应几乎是健康不佳效应的三倍;非劳动力(OLF)的负效应显著小于失业——即『不工作』本身的代价小于『想工作却没工作』。
claims.quote: The effect of unemployment is large—almost three times larger than the effect of bad health. The out of labour force (OLF) coefficient is negative and significant as well; however, it is smaller, and the hypothesis that unemploy- ment and OLF have the same effect on satisfaction can be rejected at any conventional significance level.
claims.source_title: Winkelmann & Winkelmann, 1998, Economica 65:1-15
claims.notes: 非自愿失业 vs 自愿不工作区分的早期证据。OLF 样本含提前退休、病休等,异质性大。

claims.claim: Lucas 等(德国 15 年追踪,>24,000 人):失业后生活满意度向基线回升但平均不完全恢复,即使再就业后也是如此;曾经失业的人再次失业时反应并不更轻。
claims.quote: However, on average, individuals did not completely return to their former levels of satisfaction, even after they became reemployed. Furthermore, contrary to expectations from adaptation theories, people who had experienced unemployment in the past did not react any less negatively to a new bout of unemployment than did people who had not been previously unemployed.
claims.source_title: Lucas, Clark, Georgellis & Diener, 2004, Unemployment alters the set point for life satisfaction, Psychological Science 15(1):8-13
claims.notes: SOEP;单题 0–10 生活满意度。『疤痕效应』:再就业后仍未完全恢复——说明伤害不只是当期收入或当期时间结构。

claims.claim: Clark、Diener、Georgellis、Lucas(SOEP 20 波,前后滞后模型):对结婚、离婚、丧偶、生子、被裁员都不能拒绝完全适应假设,但对失业几乎看不到适应(正式版限定为男性)。
claims.quote: We cannot reject the hypothesis of complete adaptation to marriage, divorce, widowhood, birth of child and layoff. However, there is little evidence of adaptation to unemployment for men.
claims.source_title: Clark, Diener, Georgellis & Lucas, 2008, Lags and Leads in Life Satisfaction: A Test of the Baseline Hypothesis, Economic Journal 118(529):F222-F243
claims.notes: EJ 正式版摘要(OpenAlex);CEP DP 836(2007)工作论文版措辞是『little evidence of adaptation to unemployment』未限定男性——正式版收窄到男性,引用时注意。区分『被裁』(事件,可适应)与『处于失业状态』(持续,不适应)。

claims.claim: Kassenboehmer & Haisken-DeNew(SOEP 1991–2006):用公司关闭识别外生失业入口以排除反向因果;女性因公司关闭进入失业对生活满意度有额外强负效应,所需补偿收入『巨大』,表明外生失业存在巨大非金钱成本。工作论文版估计西德女性需补偿 4.7 个对数点收入。
claims.quote: The large compensating variation in terms of income indicates enormous non‐pecuniary negative effects for women of exogenous entry unemployment due to company closures.
claims.source_title: Kassenboehmer & Haisken-DeNew, 2009, You're Fired! The Causal Negative Effect of Entry Unemployment on Life Satisfaction, Economic Journal 119(536):448-462
claims.notes: 工作论文 Ruhr Economic Papers No.63(2008):『women in West Germany would have to be compensated 4.7 log points [(0.245+1.017)/0.271] of income』;同文结论:『For men, with few exceptions, the reason for entry into (voluntary or involuntary) unemployment has no additional effect』——对男性而言,自愿还是被迫离职并不改变失业的伤害,意味着伤害来自『失业状态』而不是『被抛弃的事件』。4.7 对数点≈百倍收入,同样受收入系数衰减偏误影响,不宜字面解读。

claims.claim: Knabe 等(DRM,2008 年柏林与马格德堡,714 人:366 名全职雇员、348 名领取 ALG II 的长期失业者):失业者生活满意度 4.58 vs 就业者 7.11(差 2.53);但按时长加权的净情感几乎相同(4.24 vs 4.23),U 指数 0.17 vs 0.15、片段满意度 7.04 vs 7.23 差异均不显著。
claims.quote: The employed reported an average value of 7.11, the unemployed stated an average value of only 4.58 (Table 4). The difference of 2.53 points is statistically significant at any reasonable level. … An employed person’s average net affect is 4.23. … The unemployed report a score of 4.24. Measured by the duration-weighted net affect, the unemployed do not feel unhappy, but are in fact as happy as the employed.
claims.source_title: Knabe, Rätzel, Schöb & Weimann, 2009/2010, Dissatisfied with Life but Having a Good Day: Time-use and Well-being of the Unemployed, CESifo WP 2604 / Economic Journal 120(547):867-889
claims.notes: 引文取自 CESifo 工作论文版(2009-04),EJ 正式版摘要措辞一致。口径陷阱:失业者在职业介绍所招募、应答率约 15%、给 10 欧元报酬,雇员从电话簿抽样——两组抽样方式不同,存在选择偏误;横截面。资助方:Fritz Thyssen Foundation(Research project No. 10.07.1.086)。『…』处省略中间句子。

claims.claim: Knabe 等的机制:失业者在相同活动中更悲伤,但他们把就业者用于工作的时间用在更愉快的活动(社交等),两者相抵;作者推测失业者未调整期望(故生活满意度低)但经历了享乐适应。
claims.quote: Although the unemployed feel sadder when engaged in similar activities, they can compensate this by using the time the employed are at work in more enjoyable ways. Our finding that unemployment affects life satisfaction and experienced utility differently may be explained by the fact that people do not adjust their aspirations when becoming unemployed but face hedonic adaptation to changing life circumstances, triggered by the opportunity to use the time in a way that yields higher levels of satisfaction than working.
claims.source_title: Knabe et al., 2009, CESifo WP 2604
claims.notes: 对 AI 情景最重要的口径分叉:『日子过得怎样』(情绪)与『对人生评价如何』(生活满意度)给出相反答案。生活满意度带有社会比较与规范评价成分,情绪不带——若规范改变,生活满意度缺口可能缩小。

claims.claim: Krueger & Mueller(PATS 美国时间使用+情绪调查):失业者一天中更少疲惫、更悲伤、更不快乐;看电视和找工作时的悲伤尤其强烈;2012 年纵向数据显示再就业时悲伤骤降。
claims.quote: We find, for example, that the unemployed report feeling less tired, more sad, and less happy than the employed over the course of the day. Watching television and searching for a job are associated with notably intense feelings of sadness for the unemployed.
claims.source_title: Krueger & Mueller, 2008, The Lot of the Unemployed: A Time Use Perspective, IZA DP 3490; and 2012, Time Use, Emotional Well-Being, and Unemployment: Evidence from Longitudinal Data, AER P&P 102(3):594-599
claims.notes: 2012 AER P&P 摘要(OpenAlex):『(3) the unemployed report higher levels of sadness during specific episodes of the day than the employed; and (4) sadness decreases abruptly at the time of re-employment.』与 Knabe 2010 部分冲突:Knabe 说时长加权后情绪持平,K&M 说一天整体更悲伤。差异可能来自样本(美国 vs 德国长期失业者)、测量(单项情绪 vs 净情感)及 Knabe 的抽样偏误。

claims.claim: Di Tella、MacCulloch、Oswald(欧美约 25 万人,1970s–1990s):更慷慨的失业救济与更高的国民幸福相关,且对失业者和就业者的提升幅度相近(系数 1.25 与 1.44)——救济并未缩小就业者与失业者之间的幸福差距。
claims.quote: Moreover, the two coefficients on the benefits variable, 1.25 and 1.44, are similar. Hence an increase in the generosity of unemployment benefits helps the well-being of the unemployed and employed by a similar amount (perhaps because the employed know they may in the future lose their jobs, and the jobless know they may find a job). … The reason is that the benefits variable enters the Gap equation – where the ‘gap’ can be thought of as the difference in well-being between those with jobs and those looking for a job – with a coefficient that is insignificantly different from zero.
claims.source_title: Di Tella, MacCulloch & Oswald, 2003, The Macroeconomics of Happiness, Review of Economics and Statistics 85(4):809-827
claims.notes: 国家-年份层面 OECD 替代率,重复横截面(Eurobarometer + GSS)。关键:『钱让每个人都好过一点,但不填平失业的缺口』——与 Wulfgramm 2014 的结论方向不一致(见下)。

claims.claim: Wulfgramm(ESS,21 个欧洲国家,多层与面板估计):失业在所有国家都显著降低生活满意度,但失业救济慷慨度的调节作用『出人意料地大』——救济微薄时失业的负效应几乎翻倍;作者认为既有资源机制也有非金钱机制。积极劳动力市场政策的调节作用不稳健。
claims.quote: While unemployment has strong negative life satisfaction effects in all 21 European countries under study, the generosity of passive labour market policy moderates this effect to a surprisingly large extent: the adverse effect of unemployment is almost doubled if unemployment benefits are meagre. This moderating effect can be explained both by a resource as well as a non-pecuniary mechanism. The positive moderating effect of active labour market policy is less robust across model specifications.
claims.source_title: Melike Wulfgramm, 2014, Life satisfaction effects of unemployment in Europe: The moderating influence of labour market policy, Journal of European Social Policy 24(3):258-272
claims.notes: OpenAlex 摘要;正文付费墙未读,系数未核。口径:『翻倍』是从慷慨到微薄的对比,反过来说即最慷慨的救济也只把伤害减半左右,远未归零。与 McKee-Ryan(不显著)、Di Tella(缺口不变)冲突;差异可能来自 ESS 跨国横截面 vs 面板、救济指标定义。

claims.claim: Clark(BHPS 7 波,GHQ-12):失业者的幸福感与参照群体(地区、伴侣、家庭)失业率强正相关——周围人失业越多,失业的伤害越小;男性尤其明显,且对个体固定效应稳健。
claims.quote: The unemployed's well‐being is shown to be strongly positively correlated with reference group unemployment (at the regional, partner, or household level). This result, far stronger for men, is robust to controls for unobserved individual heterogeneity.
claims.source_title: Andrew E. Clark, 2003, Unemployment as a Social Norm: Psychological Evidence from Panel Data, Journal of Labor Economics 21(2):289-322
claims.notes: 正文付费墙未读;摘要经 OpenAlex。GHQ-12 是精神健康量表不是生活满意度。注意:社会规范效应缩小的是失业者与就业者的『差距』,并非证明伤害会消失;且被 Oesch & Lipps 2013 在德国/瑞士面板中未能复现。

claims.claim: Oesch & Lipps(SOEP 1984–2010、瑞士家庭面板 2000–2010,固定效应):没有证据表明周围高失业率能缓冲失业者幸福感下降;地区失业率高时失业同样痛;伤害既不随时间消退,反复失业也不会让它更轻。
claims.quote: Our fixed-effects estimates show no evidence for a mitigating effect of high surrounding unemployment on the subjective well-being of the unemployed. Becoming unemployed hurts as much when regional unemployment is high as when it is low. Likewise, the strongly harmful impact of being unemployed on well-being neither wears off over time, nor do repeated episodes of unemployment make it any better.
claims.source_title: Oesch & Lipps, 2013, Does Unemployment Hurt Less if There is More of it Around? A Panel Analysis of Life Satisfaction in Germany and Switzerland, European Sociological Review 29(5):955-967
claims.notes: 直接反驳『大家都失业就不痛』的外推。但地区失业率最高也就十几个百分点,远非『全民不工作』,所以两边都无法外推到 AI 全民情景;且『失业』在这些样本里仍然是被定义为偏离规范的状态。

claims.claim: Stutzer & Lalive(瑞士):用 1997 年全国失业救济公投中支持削减救济的投票比例度量『工作规范』强度;规范越强,失业者越快找到工作,且失业者生活满意度下降越大。
claims.quote: The stronger the norm, the more quickly unemployed people find a new job. This behavior can be explained by utility differences, probably due to social pressure. Unemployed people are significantly less happy than employed people and their reduction in life satisfaction is the larger, the stronger the norm is.
claims.source_title: Stutzer & Lalive, 2004, The Role of Social Work Norms in Job Searching and Subjective Well-Being, Journal of the European Economic Association 2(4):696-719
claims.notes: 接收版 PDF(2003-12)。公投以 50.8% 通过反对削减(即 49.2% 支持削减),投票率 41%。规范是地区差异而非可操控变量,属利用投票的准实验/工具变量设计。数据由瑞士经济事务国务秘书处提供。与 Clark 2003 方向一致:污名/规范是失业伤害中可变的一块。

claims.claim: Hetschko、Knabe、Schöb(SOEP 1984–2009):就业者退休时生活满意度不变(约 7.2),长期失业者退休时满意度显著上升(6.1→6.5,696 人),尽管退休前后可支配收入几乎不变——作者解释为社会规范切换带来的身份效用上升。
claims.quote: Using data from the German Socio-Economic Panel from 1984-2009, we follow persons from their working life into their retirement years and find that, on average, employed people maintain their life satisfaction upon retirement, while long-term unemployed people report a substantial increase in their life satisfaction when they retire.
claims.source_title: Hetschko, Knabe & Schöb, 2011/2014, Changing Identity: Retiring from Unemployment, SOEPpapers 399 / Economic Journal 124(575):149-166
claims.notes: 这是本线对 AI 情景最直接的证据:日常作息、收入、时间结构都几乎不变,仅『社会类别』从『该工作的人』变成『退休者』,满意度就回升。数字(6.1→6.5,n=696;就业者 n=2,115)取自工作论文表 1 描述统计,EJ 正式版未核。只针对老年、德国。也提示:若 AI 让『不工作』被社会重新分类为正当状态(类似退休),失业伤害中的规范部分可能消失,但仍不及就业者水平(6.5 vs 7.2)。

claims.claim: Pohlan(德国调查+行政数据联接,倾向得分加权 + DiD):失业显著损害社会融入感、生活满意度、经济资源与精神健康,并阻碍通常由就业满足的心理社会需要(社会地位、自我效能);影响持久,随失业时长加深,再就业后仍持续。
claims.quote: Moreover, this paper shows that becoming unemployed hinders the fulfillment of psychosocial needs that are typically associated with employment, such as social status and higher self-efficacy. The effects of job loss are long-lasting, grow more profound the longer the duration of unemployment and persist following reemployment.
claims.source_title: Laura Pohlan, 2019, Unemployment and social exclusion, Journal of Economic Behavior & Organization 164:273-299
claims.notes: OpenAlex 摘要;正文未读,系数未核。数据为 IAB PASS 面板(德国低收入家庭超采样),与 Hartz IV 收入保障下的失业者相关——即在有最低收入保障的情形下潜在功能损失仍存在。

claims.claim: Arvey、Harpaz、Liao(美国彩票中奖者邮寄调查,有效 117 人,应答率约 16%):85.5% 中奖后继续工作,仅 14.5% 辞职;工作中心度、中奖金额及二者交互显著预测是否继续工作。
claims.quote: The majority of lottery winners in our sample contin- ued to work after winning (n = 100 or 85.5%); 17 individuals opted to quit work- ing (14.5%).
claims.source_title: Arvey, Harpaz & Liao, 2004, Work Centrality and Post-Award Work Behavior of Lottery Winners, The Journal of Psychology 138(5):404-420
claims.notes: 作者主页版 PDF 页眉误印 1996,正式版为 2004。样本小、应答率 16%,中奖额多数不足以终身无忧;文中转引 Kaplan(1978)『nearly 80% of $1 million dollar winners quit working』,说明金额足够大时多数人辞职——『继续工作』高度依赖金额。MOW(1987)八国研究原书未取得,工作中心度构念出自该书(本文转述)。

claims.claim: 自我决定理论(Ryan & Deci):胜任、自主、关系三种先天心理需要满足时带来自我动机与心理健康,受挫时动机与幸福下降——该理论预测工作的价值取决于它是否满足这三种需要,而非工作本身;工作只是诸多可满足需要的领域之一。
claims.quote: The findings have led to the postulate of three innate psychological needs--competence, autonomy, and relatedness--which when satisfied yield enhanced self-motivation and mental health and when thwarted lead to diminished motivation and well-being. Also considered is the significance of these psychological needs and processes within domains such as health care, education, work, sport, religion, and psychotherapy.
claims.source_title: Ryan & Deci, 2000, Self-determination theory and the facilitation of intrinsic motivation, social development, and well-being, American Psychologist 55(1):68-78
claims.notes: PubMed/OpenAlex 摘要。SDT 与 Jahoda 的分歧:Jahoda 认为现代社会中只有就业能提供潜在功能;SDT 认为需要可以在多个领域满足,且受控(外在强制)的活动反而损害幸福——这为『不工作也能活得好』提供理论空间,但该推断属外推,非 SDT 作者对失业的直接主张。

open_questions: Jahoda, Lazarsfeld & Zeisel 1933《Die Arbeitslosen von Marienthal》原书:受版权保护,未找到合法全文;『478 户』『367 户依赖救济』『救济停发即丧失资格』等常被引用的人口与救济数字未能回到一手,只能通过 AGSÖ 档案馆与 Paul 转述。需纸本(Suhrkamp 1975 版)或英译本(Aldine 1971)核对。
Jahoda 1981 American Psychologist 36(2):184-191 与 1982《Employment and Unemployment》原文:付费墙/纸本;五种潜在功能的『原始措辞』只拿到 Paul 转引 Jahoda 1997 的版本,标 secondhand。
Paul & Moser 2009 JVB 74:264-282 正式版:ScienceDirect 403,OpenAlex 标为闭源;所有数字取自 2005 博士论文底稿,正式版的 k(237 横截面 + 87 纵向)与 d 值可能有细微差异。
Fryer 1986 Social Behaviour 1:3-23 原文:未找到在线版本,仅有 Paul 2005 转述。
MOW International Research Team 1987《The Meaning of Working》八国彩票问题百分比:原书未在线,未取得。
Wulfgramm 2014、Clark 2003、Pohlan 2019 正文付费墙:只核了摘要,系数与稳健性检验未核。
Krueger & Mueller 2012 AER P&P 全文:苏黎世大学仓库有 Anubis 反爬页,未绕过;引用的是 2008 IZA 工作论文 + 2012 摘要。
econstor.eu 有反爬挑战(Anubis),未绕过;Kassenboehmer 工作论文经 WebFetch 缓存取得。
交叉口径问题:几乎所有『救济能否补上』证据都是有期限、有条件(求职义务)、带污名的失业保险,与永久、无条件、全民 UBI 是不同处理;无一研究同时操控收入与『是否被社会定义为应工作的人』。退休研究(Hetschko 2014)最接近,但样本为老年人。
交叉口径问题:生活满意度(Winkelmann、Lucas、Clark 2008、Hetschko)、情绪/DRM(Knabe、Krueger & Mueller)、精神健康量表(Paul、McKee-Ryan、Clark 2003 的 GHQ)三类测量给出的『失业伤害多大』不可直接比较;Knabe 显示情绪可以不差而满意度大幅下降。
未找到:关于『自愿不工作』(如财务自由提前退休、长期 sabbatical)与幸福的高质量面板研究;关于 UBI 实验中『失业者因收入保障而痛苦减轻多少』的分解,应由 UBI 实验线覆盖。
